title: Network initiated transport of NAS messages

entities.name: Network initiated transport of NAS messages
entities.description: Procedure where the network sends a DOWNLINK NAS TRANSPORT message to transport NAS messages to the UE. The UE's EMM entity forwards the NAS message container contents to the SMS entity.

entities.name: DOWNLINK NAS TRANSPORT
entities.description: Message sent by the network to initiate transport of NAS messages to the UE.

entities.name: NAS message container
entities.description: Information element containing NAS messages to be transported to the UE.

entities.name: EMM entity
entities.description: EMM entity in the UE that processes NAS messages.

entities.name: SMS entity
entities.description: SMS entity in the UE that receives forwarded NAS message contents.

entities.name: EPS services with control plane CIoT EPS optimization
entities.description: Condition where UE is using EPS services with control plane CIoT EPS optimization, allowing network to initiate downlink transport even without PDN connections.

relations.description: The procedure is initiated by sending a DOWNLINK NAS TRANSPORT message.
The DOWNLINK NAS TRANSPORT message contains the NAS message container IE.
The EMM entity forwards the contents of the NAS message container IE to the SMS entity.
The EMM entity forwards NAS message contents to the SMS entity.
When UE is using EPS services with control plane CIoT EPS optimization, the network can initiate downlink transport even without PDN connections.
